retained_corpus_audit.interpretation: Most fit labels evaluate short-horizon openings, not completed full-party battles. Repeated scenarios and the same four booted training origins do not constitute 40 independent natural battles.

attack_favored_rollout.interpretation: The integrated package can select and execute an attack that wins an easy in-sample trainer battle. This does not test sustained battle control or transfer.

full_party_rollout.interpretation: The opening switch reflected the short-horizon fit, but successive switch, replacement, and attack decisions did not finish this five-member battle. The anti-switch-loop guard forced attacks after voluntary switches; it did not rescue the policy. The full-battle loss is a concrete package failure, not a reason to tune this consumed capture.

next_decision: Retire opening-only retention as evidence of full-battle readiness. Prospectively source new TRAIN battles with terminal outcomes and intermediate decision choices, then test the frozen learner against separate natural origins. Do not refit or replay the consumed pair or these diagnostic captures.
